audit.why: TRICKY / 7.5/10 on 56.95% over 590 games. The win rate is high but earned late — levels 3-5 are genuinely losing, and the rating reflects the skill cost of surviving them rather than the final result.
audit.corrected: diff, diffRating, tone and carryRating left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Renekton, Skill, Quinn, Quinn, Renekton, Quinn, Quinn in both layers. The packet reads Quinn, Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Quinn, Quinn, Quinn — and the page's own whys already argue the packet version.
audit.why: whys[0] says you out-range him and win level 1 before Ruthless Predator exists, yet the row said Renekton. whys[2] and whys[3] describe him bursting you down and his fury combo peaking, yet those rows said Quinn. whys[4] says you take over the map at 6, yet that row said Renekton. Four rows were exactly inverted against their own text.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3 and 4 re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings moved to match: 7, 6, 3, 3, 6, 6, 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the full layer names no Renekton ability except Ruthless Predator, and describes its stun only as 'empowered = long stun' with no numbers. Three real mechanics were missing entirely, and the content layer calls Slice and Dice 'Dice' as though it were separate from his E.
audit.why: Riot text — Ruthless Predator (W, 16/14/12/10/8s, 300 range): two slashes and a 0.75s stun; at 50+ Fury it is three slashes, DESTROYS damage shields on the target, and stuns 1.5 seconds. Slice and Dice (E, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, 450 range) is the double dash and shreds armour when empowered. Cull the Meek (Q, 7s) heals him off every swing, which is the anti-heal case. And Ruthless Predator's stun cancels the Behind Enemy Lines channel.
audit.corrected: All four written in with numbers: the 0.75s/1.5s stun split and the shield destruction, Slice and Dice named with its range and cooldown, Cull the Meek named as the heal that anti-heal answers, and the channel cancel stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] tells the player to 'E-knockback away'. Vault does not knock the enemy back.
audit.why: Riot text: Quinn 'dashes to an enemy... she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target'. The displacement is Quinn's own; Renekton does not move. A player expecting to shove him off will misplay the disengage.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as 'Vault away', which is what actually happens.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears in the full layer's report and late breakdown but nowhere in the content layer or the phase whys, and it is never tied to an ability.
audit.why: Cull the Meek heals on a 7s cooldown and heals more above 50 Fury — it is precisely what makes levels 3-5 unwinnable if you try to grind him down.
audit.corrected: Executioner's tied to Cull the Meek by name in phases[3].why and dosFull[1].d.

edits.before: Passive-mark AA trades win every short exchange. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You out-range him and Harrier resets win every level-1 exchange — Ruthless Predator is not online yet. Take the wave.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Renekton must walk into your range.
edits.after: His fury pool fills: empowered Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s and Slice and Dice shreds armour. Stay outside 450.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His combo damage peaks here and your only out is one Vault on 12s. Farm at max range; Cull the Meek heals your chip back, so buy Executioner's.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines exports your lead — roam on every shove. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Renekton's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Behind Enemy Lines gives roam tempo he cannot match while his lane edge plateaus — shove, vanish, and take the map.

edits.before: Survive his early — poke from range, roam + scale. Quinn wins the Ruthless Predator cooldown windows.
edits.after: Win level 1, survive 3-5, then take the map. Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s empowered — bait it out first.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Vault out. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 0.75s stun, 1.5s at 50+ fury, and it breaks shields. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Harass Renekton with marked autos, Q-blind his trade window, and vault out the instant he commits.
edits.after: Harass with Harrier autos and blind his autos — Cull the Meek still heals him, so anti-heal early.

edits.before: Renekton wastes Ruthless Predator (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is 16s at rank 1 — that whole window is yours to trade in.

edits.before: That is Renekton's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: At 50+ fury his W stuns twice as long and his E shreds armour — trade on an empty bar.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator's stun cancels a Behind Enemy Lines channel.

edits.before: Vaulting INTO the fight to feel like an assassin — Vault is your spacing reset, not an engage.
edits.after: Slice and Dice is a 450-range double dash on 16s — he closes and leaves whenever it is up.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Vault out. When it is down — Vault-blind + R him.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator, 16s at rank 1: 0.75s stun, 1.5s and shield-breaking at 50+ fury, and it cancels your R channel.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Vault out. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator, 16/14/12/10/8s: 0.75s stun, 1.5s at 50+ fury, and it breaks shields. - Slice and Dice, 16s at rank 1: the 450-range double dash in and out. - Cull the Meek, 7s: heals him — anti-heal it.

edits.before: His W stun + empowered Dice combo is his all-in window; bait the W cooldown, then blind the follow-up with Q.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator into an empowered Slice and Dice is his all-in; bait the 16s W, then blind the follow-up.

edits.before: Bait his W stun, then E-knockback away and blind his empowered combo with Q
edits.after: Bait Ruthless Predator, then Vault away and blind the empowered follow-up

edits.before: Land W stun to pin you so his fury-empowered Dice and E gap-close land in full
edits.after: Land Ruthless Predator to pin you so his empowered Slice and Dice lands in full

edits.before: Pool his fury at 6 for the empowered W chain before you can dash out with E
edits.after: Pool fury past 50 so the empowered stun holds 1.5s before you can Vault out

notes: No mirror existed, so these findings are first-hand and the renekton__quinn page will need the inverse chart when it is audited: Renekton rows at 2, 3 (Level 3 and Levels 4-5) and Quinn everywhere else. The single most useful new fact on this page is that empowered Ruthless Predator destroys damage shields — that changes whether a Doran's Shield or a Shieldbow-style buy is worth anything in the level 3-5 window, and it was nowhere on the page. Also killed 'E-knockback': Vault repositions Quinn, not the target.
